notes.title: 2K Launcher 1.3.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
[b]Features[/b]

- An Option to check for new 2K Launcher Updates - In the Application Settings, click on "Check for Updates" which will get a new update if available. Please note, the 2K Launcher will need a restart to apply the update.
- 2K Launcher is using the new 2K Logo
- Added trouble-shooting to clear cache by pressing key 'c' during app loading
[b]
Bug-Fixes[/b]

- Launcher app files are not being extracted to %LocalAppData%\T2GP Launcher
- Fixed Missing 2K icon on the Launcher window fixed in the Alt-Tab overlay and taskbar
- Fixed Incorrect string translations in Error Reporter
- [STEAM only] Game play is now fixed using Steam Streaming mod launch

notes.title: Mafia II: Definitive Edition Patch: June 18, 2020
notes.content:
Today we released patches for both [url=https://mafiagame.com/mafia-2]Mafia II: Definitive Edition[/url] and [url=https://mafiagame.com/mafia-3]Mafia III: Definitive Edition[/url] on PS4, Xbox One, and PC. Below is a list of changes for Mafia II: Definitive Edition on PC. 


[h2]Mafia II: Definitive Edition[/h2][list][*]Addressed a reported concern that the 2K Account icon was sometimes getting stuck on the screen[/*][*]Addressed a reported concern that legacy saves were sometimes not working on Steam[/*][*]Addressed reported concerns related to game audio[/*][*]Addressed reported concerns related to refining gameplay[/*][/list]

If you're experiencing any issues with either game, please let us know at [url=https://support.2k.com/]support.2k.com[/url]. Read the complete patch notes for both games at [url=https://mafiagame.com/news/mafia-patch-june-2020/]mafiagame.com[/url].
